readme_excerpt: Plyr > [!IMPORTANT] > Plyr, meet Video.js 👋 > The folks behind Plyr, Vidstack and Media Chrome have joined forces to build the latest version of Video.js: one modern, accessible player with the best of all three. Plyr will soon be deprecated, so give Video.js a try. > Try Video.js → Plyr is a simple, lightweight, accessible and customizable HTML5, YouTube and Vimeo media player that supports modern browsers.
